pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.1.2: athakho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi icchāmahaṃ bhikkhave temāsaṃ paṭisalliyituṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.1.3: namhi kenaci upasaṅkamitabbo aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakenāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.1.4: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paṭissuṇitvā nāssudha koci bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamati aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakena.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.1.5: tena kho pana samayena sāvatthiyaṃ saṅghena katikā katā hoti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.1.7: na bhagavā kenaci upasaṅkamitabbo aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakena
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.1.9: athakho āyasmā upaseno vaṅgantaputto sapariso yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.1.10: āciṇṇaṃ kho panetaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ āgantukehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodituṃ. athakho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ upasenaṃ vaṅgantaputtaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.1.11: kacci vo upasena khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.1.14: appakilamathena ca mayaṃ bhante addhānaṃ āgatāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.1.15: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato upasenassa vaṅgantaputtassa saddhivihāriko bhikkhu bhagavato avidūre nisinno hoti. athakho bhagavā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.1.17: na kho me bhante manāpāni paṃsukūlānīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.1.19: upajjhāyo me bhante paṃsukūliko evaṃ ahaṃpi paṃsukūlikoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.1.20: athakho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ upasenaṃ vaṅgantaputtaṃ etadavoca pāsādikā kho tyāyaṃ upasena parisā
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.1.22: yo maṃ bhante upasampadaṃ yācati tamahaṃ evaṃ vadāmi
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.1.23: ahaṃ kho āvuso āraññako piṇḍapātiko paṃsukūliko
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.1.24: sace tvaṃpi āraññako bhavissasi piṇḍapātiko paṃsukūliko evāhaṃ taṃ upasampādessāmīti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.1.25: sace me paṭissuṇāti upasampādemi no ce me paṭissuṇāti na upasampādemi
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.1.26: yo maṃ nissayaṃ yācati tamahaṃ evaṃ vadāmi
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.1.27: ahaṃ kho āvuso āraññako piṇḍapātiko paṃsukūliko
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.1.28: sace tvaṃpi āraññako bhavissasi piṇḍapātiko paṃsukūliko evāhaṃ te nissayaṃ dassāmīti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.1.29: sace me paṭissuṇāti nissayaṃ demi no ce me paṭissuṇāti na demi
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.1.30: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante parisaṃ vinemīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.2.1: sādhu sādhu upasena sādhu kho tvaṃ upasena parisaṃ vinesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.2.2: jānāsi pana tvaṃ upasena sāvatthiyaṃ saṅghassa katikanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.2.3: na kho ahaṃ bhante jānāmi sāvatthiyaṃ saṅghassa katikanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.2.4: sāvatthiyaṃ kho upasena saṅghena katikā katā
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.2.6: na bhagavā kenaci upasaṅkamitabbo aññatra ekena biṇḍapātanīhārakena
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.2.8: paññāyissati bhante sāvatthiyaṃ saṅgho sakāya katikāya
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.2.9: na mayaṃ appaññattaṃ paññāpessāma paññattaṃ vā na samucchindissāma
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.2.12: na appaññattaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ paññattaṃ vā na samucchinditabbaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.2.14: anujānāmi upasena ye te bhikkhū āraññakā biṇḍapātikā paṃsukūlikā yathāsukhaṃ maṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamantūti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.2.15: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitā honti mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ upasenaṃ vaṅgantaputtaṃ pācittiyaṃ desāpessāmāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.2.16: athakho āyasmā upaseno vaṅgantaputto sapariso uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.2.17: athakho te bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ upasenaṃ vaṅgantaputtaṃ etadavocuṃ jānāsi tvaṃ āvuso upasena sāvatthiyaṃ saṅghassa katikanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.2.18: bhagavāpi maṃ āvuso evamāha jānāsi pana tvaṃ upasena sāvatthiyaṃ saṅghassa katikanti na kho ahaṃ bhante jānāmi sāvatthiyaṃ saṅghassa katikanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.2.19: sāvatthiyaṃ kho upasena saṅghena katikā katā
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.2.21: na bhagavā kenaci upasaṅkamitabbo aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakena
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.2.23: paññāyissati bhante sāvatthiyaṃ saṅgho sakāya katikāya
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.2.24: na mayaṃ appaññattaṃ paññāpessāma paññattaṃ vā na samucchindissāma
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.2.26: anuññātāvuso bhagavatā ye te bhikkhū āraññakā piṇḍapātikā paṃsukūlikā yathāsukhaṃ maṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamantūti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.2.27: athakho te bhikkhū saccaṃ kho āyasmā upaseno vaṅgantaputto āha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.2.28: na appaññattaṃ paññāpetabbaṃ paññattaṃ vā na samucchinditabbaṃ yathāpaññattesu sikkhāpadesu samādāya vattitabbanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.3.1: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū anuññātā kira bhagavatā ye te bhikkhū āraññakā piṇḍapātikā paṃsukūlikā yathāsukhaṃ maṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamantūti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.3.2: te bhagavantaṃ dassanāya pihayantā santhatāni ujjhitvā āraññakaṅgaṃ piṇḍapātikaṅgaṃ paṃsukūlikaṅgaṃ samādiyiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.3.3: athakho bhagavā sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ senāsanacārikaṃ āhiṇḍanto addasa santhatāni tahiṃ tahiṃ ujjhitāni
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.3.4: passitvāna bhikkhū āmantesi kassimāni bhikkhave santhatāni tahiṃ tahiṃ ujjhitānīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.3.5: athakho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.3.6: athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.3.7: tenahi bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpessāmi dasa atthavase paṭicca
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.3.8: saṅghasuṭṭhutāya saṅghaphāsutāya dummaṅkūnaṃ puggalānaṃ niggahāya pesalānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ phāsuvihārāya diṭṭhadhammikānaṃ āsavānaṃ saṃvarāya samparāyikānaṃ āsavānaṃ paṭighātāya appasannānaṃ pasādāya pasannānaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya saddhammaṭṭhitiyā vinayānuggahāya
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.3.9: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.3.10.1: nisīdanasanthataṃ pana bhikkhunā kārayamānena purāṇasanthatassa sāmantā sugatavidatthi ādātabbā dubbaṇṇakaraṇāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:1.3.11: anādā ce bhikkhu purāṇasanthatassa sāmantā sugatavidatthiṃ navaṃ nisīdanasanthataṃ kārāpeyya nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:2.10: thirabhāvāya vaṭṭaṃ vā caturassaṃ vā chinditvā ekadese vā santharitabbaṃ vijaṭetvā vā santharitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:2.11: anādā ce bhikkhu purāṇasanthatassa sāmantā sugatavidatthinti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:2.12: anādiyitvā purāṇasanthatassa sāmantā sugatavidatthiṃ navaṃ nisīdanasanthataṃ karoti vā kārāpeti vā payoge dukkaṭaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:2.14: nissajjitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:2.17: idaṃ me bhante nisīdanasanthataṃ anādiyitvā purāṇasanthatassa sāmantā sugatavidatthiṃ kārāpitaṃ nissaggiyaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:2.22.1: attanā vippakataṃ attanā pariyosāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:2.23: attanā vippakataṃ parehi pariyosāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:2.24: parehi vippakataṃ attanā pariyosāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:2.25: parehi vippakataṃ parehi pariyosāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:2.26: aññassatthāya karoti vā kārāpeti vā āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np15:2.32: vitānaṃ vā bhummattharaṇaṃ vā sāṇipākāraṃ vā bhisiṃ vā bimbohanaṃ vā karoti
